# Test fixtures

Only commit **minimal, synthetic or explicitly redacted, reproducible** fixtures here.

Do not copy a live MirrorOrder workspace into this directory. In particular, fixtures must not contain real production media, customer scripts, private FCPXML projects, device-local paths, API keys, Review/Editorial state from a live job, or large generated caches.

Prefer fixtures that are generated in the test itself. Keep a checked-in fixture only when a stable byte-for-byte sample materially improves a parser/contract test.
